activity_summary: At nine you rehearsed entrances and not speeches. John would have no new matter before dinner. Kemp added nothing. You did not tell him about the king. You said you had to be home before noon.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the rehearsal to doors, and named noon.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Refused a new matter before dinner.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Took his door and added nothing.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have nothing new to put in your mouth.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: I am not adding a line at nine in the morning.
